definitions.explanation: A fight or argument between people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{喧嘩|けんか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a fight with my friend.

examples.japanese: {喧嘩|けんか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。

notes:
{喧嘩|けんか} is a noun/suru-verb for quarrels, arguments, or fights.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {喧嘩|けんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fight/quarrel)
- {喧嘩|けんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to turn into a fight)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{喧嘩|けんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (fight with ~)
- {喧嘩|けんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to pick a fight)
- {喧嘩|けんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to accept a challenge)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{口喧嘩|くちげんか}→口喧嘩：08454_kuchigenka⟧: verbal argument
- ⟦{夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}→夫婦喧嘩：27991_fuufugenka⟧: marital fight

Note: Often written in hiragana (けんか) in casual contexts.
